capabilities: Encrypt selected text into an inline or fenced encrypted token
Decrypt read-only into a modal without rewriting the file
Decrypt in place to edit, then re-encrypt
Render tokens as clickable lock pills in reading view
Cache the session password with a status bar lock indicator
disambiguation: Not a whole-note or whole-vault encryption tool; it encrypts only the text you select, and unselected text, titles and file names stay readable.
extras: README warns that File recovery snapshots, Obsidian Sync version history, undo history, search index and backups can retain pre-encryption plaintext, and that there is no password recovery. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it for one threat: someone getting the vault files, such as a stolen laptop, a synced folder on a compromised machine, or a readable backup.
problem: Encryption tools for Obsidian work on whole notes or whole vaults, so you cannot encrypt a single password, recovery code or paragraph inside an otherwise ordinary note.
summary: Selection-level encryption plugin that replaces highlighted text in a note with an AES-256-GCM encrypted token, decryptable with a password.
